items.title: Your Medicare Plan’s 2027 Changes Have to Reach You by September 30. The Numbers That Cost You Are Easy to Miss.
items.summary: Every September, Medicare plans mail a document most enrollees skim past without realizing the page after the premium notice can quietly rewrite their entire healthcare budget for the coming year.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock's Biggest Risk Sits In The Commercial Book
items.summary: Medicare's improvement is real but not a turn in cost trend, while commercial costs keep running higher and the margin fix there has slipped again.

items.title: 5 HMO Stocks to Watch Amid Steady Premium Flow, Increased Digitization
items.summary: An aging U.S. population, digital transformation, a diversified membership mix and strategic M&A are likely to drive the performance of the Zacks Medical-HMO industry players. UNH, CI, HUM, CNC and MOH are poised to benefit from favorable industry prospects.

items.title: Is The Pullback In UNH Stock A Glitch Or A Warning?
items.summary: The healthcare giant is wrestling with costs in one part of its business, and the stock's recent dip has investors wondering if this is the moment to step in.

items.title: Is UnitedHealth Finding a Better Path to Medicare Advantage Growth?
items.summary: UNH is prioritizing Medicare Advantage profitability over membership growth, using tighter benefits, pricing and cost controls to improve margins.

items.title: Can Humana's Star Ratings Rebound Unlock MA Earnings Power?
items.summary: HUM's Star Ratings recovery is set to show early progress, but October's CMS release will test its MA turnaround and path to a 2028 margin target.

items.title: Humana taps physician executive as new chief medical officer
items.summary: Dr. Shantanu Nundy is joining the Kentucky-based insurer from health navigation firm Accolade. He’s had a varied career — advising the FDA on AI, teaching, working for the World Bank, practicing medicine and more.

items.title: Q2 Earnings Highlights: Humana (NYSE:HUM) Vs The Rest Of The Health Insurance Providers Stocks
items.summary: As the craze of earnings season draws to a close, here’s a look back at some of the most exciting (and some less so) results from Q2. Today, we are looking at health insurance providers stocks, starting with Humana (NYSE:HUM).
